policy: Source metadata only. A source entry is not a company record and does not imply a live API connection or bulk-data permission.

sources.name: Company Master Data
sources.authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs via Open Government Data Platform India
sources.authentication: Check current OGD API registration and terms before automated access
sources.coverage: Companies registered with Indian Registrar of Companies; published fields include CIN, name, status, class, category, capital, registration date, state, ROC and business activity.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the dataset scope and update cycle; it is not a directory of every freelancer, sole proprietor or informal business.
Confirm API key requirements, dataset licence, rate limits and latest schema before ingestion.

sources.name: MCA Corporate Data Management Portal
sources.authentication: Portal interaction may require CAPTCHA; no public API confirmed in this source review
sources.coverage: Company Master Details, LLP Master Data and Foreign Master Data portal views.
limitations: CAPTCHA and portal controls make this unsuitable for unattended scraping.
Use permitted portal exports or official access only.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR Submissions and Company Facts APIs
sources.authentication: No API key required for data.sec.gov; automated access must comply with SEC fair-access and User-Agent requirements.
sources.coverage: SEC filing entities and public reporting companies with EDGAR submissions/XBRL data.
limitations: Not a complete register of all US incorporated companies, private businesses, sole proprietors or state-registered entities.
Use SEC company identifiers and filing scope; do not treat EDGAR presence as state incorporation verification.

sources.name: Companies House Public Data API
sources.authority: Companies House, Department for Business and Trade
sources.authentication: Companies House API key or supported OAuth credentials required; follow published rate limits and terms.
sources.coverage: Limited companies and other entities within Companies Act 2006 scope; supports company search, profile and other register data.
limitations: Does not represent every sole trader or unincorporated business in the UK.
API credentials and terms are required; check current limits before ingestion.

sources.name: National Economic Register / Growth
sources.authority: UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism with connected licensing authorities
sources.authentication: Public portal lookup exists; no public developer API confirmed in this source review.
sources.coverage: Unified business-licence search across participating federal and emirate authorities; national ERN context.
limitations: Do not assume every free-zone or emirate record is available through a bulk public API.
Cross-check relevant emirate DED or free-zone registrar where required.

sources.name: Dubai Business Directory
sources.authority: Invest in Dubai / Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
sources.authentication: Portal lookup; no public API confirmed in this source review.
sources.coverage: Business search in Dubai by business name, trade name, keyword or Dubai Unified Licence number.
limitations: Dubai-specific; not a national UAE-wide register.
Use authority-provided access methods only; no scraping assumption.
